name: spartan-desktop
description: Spartan IDE desktop shell -- real Electron + React frontend driving the existing Rust core (spartan-buffer, tree-sitter, LSP/DAP, Leo, spartan-git) over a local IPC service. See CLAUDE.md/docs/architecture-spec.md for why this exists alongside crates/spartan-editor-core (the original wgpu-native shell, kept as the backend proof-of-concept and reference).

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
